Automatic checks run Git without a repos: Automatic checks run Git without a repository's own settings, filters and hooks, so nothing in a repository can run code just by being in these folders. For Git LFS that means files you edited may show as changed until Git refreshes. A trusted repository runs its own Git settings, including LFS, during automatic checks and fetches, so its counts are exact. Trust applies to the repository at that exact path; moving or renaming it removes the trust.
